title: Stablecoin Trust Verification Standard
summary: Defines deterministic, machine-verifiable requirements for the trust basis of fiat-referenced, reserve-backed stablecoins, covering supply, liabilities, reserves, custody, redemption, and independent attestation. It determines whether a stablecoin satisfies those requirements at a specified verification point. It does not predict market price, does not guarantee against de-pegging, and does not certify legal compliance in any jurisdiction.
citation: RuleMark. Stablecoin Trust Verification Standard (RM-S-STABLE-001, v1.0-F). RuleMark Canonical Standards Registry.
